questions.question: What does the Spanish word adiós mean?
questions.explanation: Adiós means goodbye. It comes from 'a Dios' - 'to God' - like saying 'go with God' when you leave.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: adiós is goodbye.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word blanco mean in English?
questions.explanation: Blanco means white. Think of a blank white page - blank and blanco sound almost the same.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say happy in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Feliz means happy. Say it with a smile: fe-LEEZ - the sound itself feels cheerful.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say hello in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Hola means hello. It sounds like 'oh-la' - wave and say it when you meet someone.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word lunes mean in English?
questions.explanation: Lunes means Monday. It is the first day of the school week, named after the moon - luna.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say two in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Dos means two. Hold up two fingers: dos rhymes with 'dose' - two of them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word verde mean in English?
questions.explanation: Verde means green. Think of green leaves and grass - verde is the color of growing things.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word sábado mean in English?
questions.explanation: Sábado means Saturday. It is the weekend day for rest and play - the accent falls on the first a: SA-ba-do.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say Saturday in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Saturday in Spanish is sábado. Remember the accent: SA-ba-do, the day the weekend starts.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say teacher in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Maestro means teacher. A maestro is the master of the classroom - maestro and master share the same root.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for December?
questions.explanation: Diciembre is December, the last month of the year - it ends with the winter holidays.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: diciembre ends the year.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word primo mean?
questions.explanation: Primo means cousin (male).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: primo is cousin.

questions.question: Which verb means to be (permanent traits) in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Ser is used for permanent traits like identity and origin.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ser is for what things are.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word gracias mean in English?
questions.explanation: Gracias means thank you. It comes from 'gracia', grace - saying gracias is giving grace to someone who helped you.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say father in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Padre means father. You hear it in 'padre' at church too - the priest is called padre, like a father.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word hermana mean in English?
questions.explanation: Hermana means sister. Her- sounds like 'her' - your hermana is her, your sister.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you count from 1 to 5 in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Count them in order: uno (1), dos (2), tres (3), cuatro (4), cinco (5). Say them like a song and the order sticks.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: count it like a song: uno dos tres.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word maestro mean in English?
questions.explanation: Maestro means teacher. The maestro stands at the front of the class, like the master of an orchestra.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say please in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Por favor means please. Add it to any request - 'por favor' makes asking polite.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word tío mean?
questions.explanation: Tío means uncle. The accent on the i matters: tio without it is not a word - TI-o is your uncle.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: tío is uncle.

questions.question: What number is quince in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Quince means fifteen. Remember the party: a quinceañera celebrates a girl turning fifteen.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: quince is fifteen.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word libro mean in English?
questions.explanation: Libro means book. It sounds like 'library' - a library is full of libros.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say small in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Pequeño means small. The ñ sounds like 'ny' - pe-KEN-yo - a small thing with a small sound.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say one in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Uno means one. Uno is the first number - and the name of the card game where you shout 'Uno!' with one card left.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word cinco mean in English?
questions.explanation: Cinco means five. Hold up one hand: five fingers, cinco - the C sounds like S: SIN-ko.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say I love you in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Te quiero means I love you. Word by word: te (you) + quiero (I want/love) - 'I love you' is 'I want you' in Spanish.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: te quiero is I love you.

questions.question: How do you say star in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Estrella means star. Look for the 'estrella' in the night sky - it starts with 'est', like the star in 'stellar'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: Which word means pink in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Rosa means pink. Rosa is also the word for a rose flower - pink like a rose.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rosa is pink.

questions.question: How do you say It is 3 o'clock in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Son las tres means It is three o'clock. Use son for hours after one.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: son las tres is three o'clock.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word grande mean in English?
questions.explanation: Grande means big. A grand house is a grande house - grande and grand are cousins.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say thank you in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Gracias means thank you. It is the first polite word to learn - use it every time someone helps you.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word padre mean in English?
questions.explanation: Padre means father. Think of 'paternal' - padre is the paternal parent, your father.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What number is seis in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Seis means six - it comes after cinco and before siete.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: seis is six.

questions.question: What number is ocho in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Ocho means eight. Ocho starts with O, like the number 8 looks like two O's stacked.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ocho is eight.

questions.question: Which word means yellow in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Amarillo means yellow. Picture the yellow sun - amarillo starts with A, like the 'a' in 'banana', which is yellow.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: amarillo is yellow.

questions.question: How do you ask What is your name? in Spanish?
questions.explanation: ¿Cómo te llamas? means 'What is your name?' Word by word: cómo (how) + te (you) + llamas (you call yourself) - 'How do you call yourself?'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ¿cómo te llamas? asks for a name.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word escuela mean in English?
questions.explanation: Escuela means school. Escuela and 'school' both come from the same old Greek word for learning.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word estudiante mean in English?
questions.explanation: Estudiante means student. The estudiante studies at the escuela - student and study share the same root.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word amarillo mean in English?
questions.explanation: Amarillo means yellow. Yellow like a lemon - amarillo is the color of lemons and sunshine.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does De nada mean?
questions.explanation: De nada means you are welcome, said after gracias.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: de nada answers gracias.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word niño mean in English?
questions.explanation: Niño means boy. The ñ sounds like 'ny' - NEE-nyo - and a niño is a young boy.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word perro mean in English?
questions.explanation: Perro means dog. Say it with a rolled R: PEH-rro - dogs in Spanish say 'guau', not 'woof'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word tres mean in English?
questions.explanation: Tres means three. Tres sounds like 'trace' the number 3 - three sides on a triangle, tres.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word sol mean in English?
questions.explanation: Sol means sun. Sol is also the name of our sun in science - the solar system is the sol system.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word estudiante mean?
questions.explanation: Estudiante means student. If you go to school, you are an estudiante - one who studies.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: estudiante is student.

questions.question: How do you say I like pizza in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Me gusta means it pleases me, so Me gusta la pizza is I like pizza.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: me gusta flips the sentence around.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word diez mean in English?
questions.explanation: Diez means ten. Ten fingers, diez - it rhymes with 'yes' in sound: dee-EZ.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say I am from Arizona in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Soy de Arizona means I am from Arizona. Use ser for where you are from.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: soy de means I am from.

questions.question: What does Buenos días mean?
questions.explanation: Buenos días means good morning. Días has an accent: DEE-as - say it when the sun comes up.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: buenos días greets the morning.

questions.question: How do you say I like soccer in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Me gusta el fútbol means I like soccer. Fútbol is football - the same game, and me gusta works for every 'I like'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: me gusta works the same for every like.

questions.question: How do you say hot in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Caliente means hot. Hot like chili - caliente starts with 'cal', like calories that make you feel warm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you ask How are you? in Spanish?
questions.explanation: ¿Cómo estás? means 'How are you?' Cómo (how) + estás (you are) - it asks how someone feels right now.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ¿cómo estás? asks how someone feels.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word escribir mean in English?
questions.explanation: Escribir means to write. You write with a pencil - escribir ends in -ir, like many Spanish verbs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: escribir is to write.

questions.question: How do you say blue in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Azul means blue. Blue like the sky - azul sounds like 'azure', the blue of the sky.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word leer mean in English?
questions.explanation: Leer means to read. Leer looks like 'leer' in English but means to read - read a libro to leer.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: leer is to read.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word casa mean?
questions.explanation: Casa means house. Casa sounds like 'castle' - a castle is a very big casa.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: casa is house.

questions.question: How do you say Thursday in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Jueves means Thursday. It is the fourth school day - named after Jupiter, like Thursday is named after Thor.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say yes in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Sí means yes. The accent matters: si without it means 'if' - SÍ with the accent is yes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word abuela mean?
questions.explanation: Abuela means grandmother. Abuela is your mother's mother - 'abuela' sounds like 'a boo' from grandma's hug.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: abuela is grandma.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word madre mean in English?
questions.explanation: Madre means mother. Madre and 'maternal' share the same root - your madre is your maternal parent.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word agua mean in English?
questions.explanation: Agua means water. Agua sounds like 'aqua' - aqua is the color of water.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word hola mean in English?
questions.explanation: Hola means hello. Hola is the friendliest word in Spanish - say it with a wave.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: Which is the correct definite article for casa (house)?
questions.explanation: Casa is feminine, so it takes la.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: la goes with feminine nouns.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word comer mean in English?
questions.explanation: Comer means to eat. Comer starts with 'com', like 'come' to the table to eat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: comer is to eat.

questions.question: Which word means the color orange in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Naranja means orange, both the color and the fruit.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: naranja is orange.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word cuatro mean in English?
questions.explanation: Cuatro means four. Four sides on a square - cuatro sounds like 'quarter', one of four parts.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say What time is it? in Spanish?
questions.explanation: ¿Qué hora es? means 'What time is it?' Qué (what) + hora (hour) + es (is) - 'What hour is it?'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ¿qué hora es? asks the time.

questions.question: How do you say Good night in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Buenas noches means good night. Noches has an accent on the o: NO-ches - say it when the day ends.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: buenas noches ends the day.

questions.question: How do you say sad in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Triste means sad. Triste sounds like 'tears' - when you are triste, tears may come.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word agua mean?
questions.explanation: Agua means water. You drink agua when you are thirsty - aqua, water, agua.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: agua is water.

questions.question: How do you say school in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Escuela means school. The escuela is where estudiantes learn - school, escuela, learning.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: Which word means blue in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Azul means blue. Blue like the ocean - azul is the color of the sea and sky.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: azul is blue.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word dos mean in English?
questions.explanation: Dos means two. Two shoes, dos - hold up two fingers to remember it.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say boy in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Niño means boy. A niño is a young boy - remember the ñ, it sounds like 'ny'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say ten in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Diez means ten. Count to ten on your fingers: uno, dos, tres... diez is the last one.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say big in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Grande means big. A grande elephant is a big elephant - grande and grand mean the same.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say Good afternoon in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Buenas tardes means good afternoon. Tardes is the afternoon - say it after lunch, when the sun is high.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: buenas tardes is for the afternoon.

questions.question: How do you say Good morning in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Buenos días means good morning. Say it when you wake up - días means days, so you are wishing good days.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: buenos días starts the day.

questions.question: Which word means red in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Rojo means red. Rojo is the color of a ripe apple and a red balloon - say RO-ho.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rojo is red.

questions.question: How do you say I am 12 years old in Spanish?
questions.explanation: In Spanish you say I have twelve years: Tengo doce años.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: age uses tener, to have.

questions.question: How do you say five in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Cinco means five. Five fingers on one hand - cinco starts with the same sound as 'sink'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word triste mean in English?
questions.explanation: Triste means sad. When you feel triste, you feel down - triste and 'tears' start with the same sound.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say goodbye in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Adiós means goodbye. Wave and say adiós when you leave - it comes from 'a Dios', 'to God'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: Which word means purple in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Morado means purple. Morado is the color of grapes - purple grapes are morado.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: morado is purple.

questions.question: How do you say book in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Libro means book. A libro is full of words - it sounds like 'library', where libros live.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word tía mean in English?
questions.explanation: Tía means aunt - the feminine form of tío (uncle).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: tía is aunt, tío is uncle.

questions.question: How do you say cold in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Frío means cold. Frío has an accent on the i: FREE-o - cold like ice and snow.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say brother in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Hermano means brother. Hermano and hermana are brother and sister - they share the 'herman' root.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word negro mean in English?
questions.explanation: Negro means black. Negro is the color of night - black like the night sky.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say Friday in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Viernes means Friday. Friday is the last school day - viernes ends the school week.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does ¿Cuántos años tienes? mean?
questions.explanation: ¿Cuántos años tienes? means 'How old are you?' Cuántos (how many) + años (years) + tienes (you have) - in Spanish you 'have' years, you don't 'are' years.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ¿cuántos años tienes? asks your age.

questions.question: What does por favor mean?
questions.explanation: Por favor means please. Please makes any request polite - say por favor when you ask for something.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: por favor makes requests polite.

questions.question: What number is nueve in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Nueve means nine - one more than ocho.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: nueve is nine.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for January?
questions.explanation: Enero is January, the first month of the year - it starts the new year.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: enero starts the year.

questions.question: How do you say Sunday in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Domingo means Sunday. Domingo is the day of rest - it comes from the Latin word for 'the Lord's day'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: How do you say sun in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Sol means sun. The sol rises in the morning and sets at night - solar power comes from the sol.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word comida mean in English?
questions.explanation: Comida means food. Comida is what you eat - it shares a root with 'comer', to eat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: How do you say moon in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Luna means moon. Luna is the moon - and lunes, Monday, is the moon's day, named after the luna.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: say it out loud three times to remember it.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word casa mean in English?
questions.explanation: Casa means house. Your casa is where you live - casa sounds like 'castle', a house for kings.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: work both ways: English to Spanish and back.

questions.question: What does the Spanish word abuelo mean in English?
questions.explanation: Abuelo means grandfather - the masculine form of abuela (grandmother).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: abuelo is grandpa.
